map.每日谜题挑战是做什么的？: What does Daily Riddle Challenge do?
map.如何使用每日谜题挑战？: How do I use Daily Riddle Challenge?
map.每日谜题挑战适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Daily Riddle Challenge best for?
map.🧩 每日谜题挑战：日期种子 · 三级提示 · 连击积分: 🧩 Daily Riddle Challenge: Date Seed · 3-tier Hints · Combo Points
map.每天一道中文谜题或脑筋急转弯，用当天日期做种子，保证同一天所有人拿到同一道题、隔: One Chinese riddle or brain teaser per day, seeded by the current date so everyone gets the same puzzle on the same day and a new one appears the next day. Supports 3-tier keyword hints, scoring, combo records and difficulty choice, plus a 'beat x% of players' percentile estimate; scores and combos are saved locally and survive refresh.
map.动动脑筋，下面可以要提示哦。: Use your brain; hints are available below.
map.还没有使用提示。点击下面的按钮逐次揭示关键词。: No hints used yet. Click the buttons below to reveal keywords one by one.
map.说明：本工具的“超越 x% 玩家”百分位是基于难度基线与提示使用次数模拟的趣味估: Note: the "beat x% of players" percentile here is a fun estimate simulated from the difficulty baseline and number of hints used, not real statistics; riddle answers are mainly Chinese, and spaces and punctuation are auto-ignored on submission.
map.日常挑战：全球同日同题，按日期种子出题，和朋友比谁先解。: Daily challenge: same puzzle worldwide on the same day, seeded by date; race friends to solve first.
map.阶梯提示：三级难度 + 三级提示，卡住时渐进给关键词。: Tiered hints: 3 difficulty levels + 3 hint levels, gradually revealing keywords when stuck.
map.积分连击：连续答对攒连击加分，答题日历记录坚持天数。: Points and combo: consecutive correct answers build a combo multiplier; an answer calendar tracks your streak days.
map.题目由日期种子生成（同一天所有人同题），含三级难度与三级可展开提示；答对得分、连: Puzzles are generated from a date seed (same for everyone on the same day), with 3 difficulty levels and 3 expandable hints; correct answers score, consecutive correct answers trigger a combo multiplier, and the answer calendar marks consecutive check-in days. The puzzle bank keeps expanding.
map.某日中难度题，三级提示依次给「动物 / 会飞 / 候鸟」→ 答案「大雁」；答对: On a certain day a medium puzzle gives 3 hints in order: "animal / can fly / migratory bird" -> answer "wild goose"; correct +10 points, and if combo x3 then +30 that day. 7 consecutive correct days unlock a calendar badge; a missed day resets the combo but the calendar keeps history.
map.同一天大家题目一样吗？: Does everyone get the same puzzle on the same day?
map.一样。按日期种子生成，全球同题，便于公平比拼与讨论。: Yes. Generated by date seed, same worldwide, convenient for fair competition and discussion.
map.提示本身不减分，但展开提示会中断连击倍数；想拿高分就少看提示。: Hints themselves do not subtract points, but expanding a hint breaks the combo multiplier; to score high, use fewer hints.
